name: 画像に重ねた注目記事カード
prompt: Create one 1085x879 Japanese featured-article card. Use the source crop for the tall image-first card proportions and the headline-over-image hierarchy. Use the localized native preview as the authority for the Japanese illustration, wording, and Lighthouse colors. Build an upper pale mint panel (#D1FAE5) with a centered two-line headline 「伝わるデザインを」「つくる言葉」, surrounded by four thin green outlined circles labeled 「質問」「モデル」「書式」「動き」. Below, place a deep evergreen rounded panel (#064E3B) with the small source label 「まちの編集室」, the bold white two-line headline 「デザインの言葉を知る。」「伝わる表現のための語彙」, and a muted short summary 「14のテーマから、考え方を学びます。」. Use the preview's pale mint outer field (#ECFDF5), #047857 accents, and Meiryo Regular/Bold. Keep the compact card composition, clear type hierarchy, and simple editorial graphic. No English text, logos, photos, gradients, shadows, or added decoration. Flat UI component only.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
